section_summary.extract_value: This Discussion section presents findings from a study examining body appreciation as a mediator between interpersonal/intrapersonal variables and well-being outcomes in college women. The model explained 40.5% of variance in body appreciation, with body appreciation playing a key mediational role between maladaptive perfectionism, attachment anxiety, and caregiver eating messages on one hand, and intuitive eating on the other. However, body appreciation did not uniquely predict depressive symptoms, suggesting it is not simply the mirror opposite of body dissatisfaction.
section_summary.evidence_source: Opening paragraph: 'In this study, we explored a model including potential interpersonal (i.e., adult attachment, caregiver eating messages) and intrapersonal (i.e., maladaptive and adaptive perfectionism) barriers and facilitators to body appreciation...' and subsequent paragraphs detailing the model's findings.
